firmware.title: Poisk (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The Poisk-1, a Soviet IBM PC/XT relative, with its cartridge RAM and floppy drive. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
